name: ai-chat-stream
summary: Streaming chat route on the Anthropic TypeScript SDK: auth, per-user rate limit before spend, strict input caps, max_tokens + timeout, abort on client disconnect, key server-only.
adapt: src/lib/auth.ts requireUser(): wire to your auth provider (it returns 401 until you do).
src/lib/rate-limit.ts: swap the in-memory window for a shared store (Upstash/Redis) before multi-instance deploys; add a daily token quota per user.
route.ts MODEL, MAX_TOKENS, SYSTEM, effort: tune against your eval set (ai-features references/patterns.md §7).
Client: read res.body with a reader and wire the Stop button to an AbortController passed to fetch(); render the text as text, never as raw HTML.
Persist the conversation after the stream ends (where usage is logged), owner-scoped like owner-scoped-api.
Refusals: the stream ends with stop_reason 'refusal'; show a message, or add the SDK's server-side fallbacks (claude-api skill).
